description.desc_thousand_char: EPL Limited (EL) was formerly known as Essel Propack Limited. As per its credit rating report, it is engaged in the business of manufacturing laminated plastic tubes and laminates. Its products are used in the packaging of products across categories, such as oral care, beauty and cosmetics, pharma and health, foods, and home care. The company has 21 manufacturing plants across multiple regions in the world, including Africa, the Middle East, and SOuth Asia, East Asia Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. It offers products in categories such as laminates, laminated tubes, extruded tubes, caps and closures, and many more. Its clientele includes Tesco, Revlon, Reckitt, Marks Spencer, Marico, Indoco, Liby, ITC Limited, and many more.
